name: Germany
summary: Section 323c of the Strafgesetzbuch punishes failing to render assistance in an accident, common danger or emergency when help is necessary and reasonable to expect. Statutory accident insurance covers people who help in such situations, and federal law sets up a national volunteer service and tax rules for donations and volunteer payments.

duty_to_help.detail: Section 323c(1) StGB punishes anyone who does not render assistance in an accident, common danger or emergency although it is necessary and can reasonably be expected under the circumstances, in particular if possible without substantial danger to that person and without breaching other important duties. The penalty is imprisonment of up to one year or a fine. Section 323c(2) punishes obstructing a person who is helping or wants to help.

good_samaritan.detail: Section 2(1) no. 13 a) of Book VII of the Sozialgesetzbuch (SGB VII) makes people who render assistance in accidents, common danger or emergencies, or rescue another from significant present danger to health, insured by law under statutory accident insurance. In the Bürgerliches Gesetzbuch, Section 680 limits the liability of a person acting to avert an urgent danger to the other party to intent and gross negligence, and Section 683 lets such a helper claim reimbursement of expenses under the stated conditions. I did not review how courts apply these provisions.

promotion.title: Tax deduction for donations
promotion.detail: Section 10b of the Einkommensteuergesetz allows donations and membership fees for tax-privileged purposes to be deducted as special expenses, up to 20 percent of total income (or a turnover-based alternative), subject to the conditions in the section.
promotion.publisher: Federal Ministry of Justice via Gesetze im Internet

promotion.title: Tax exemption for part-time volunteer income
promotion.detail: Section 3 no. 26a of the Einkommensteuergesetz exempts income from certain part-time activities that serve charitable, benevolent and church purposes, up to a stated annual amount (960 euros in the version I fetched).
promotion.publisher: Federal Ministry of Justice via Gesetze im Internet

promotion.title: Bundesfreiwilligendienst (Federal Volunteer Service)
promotion.detail: The Bundesfreiwilligendienstgesetz establishes a federal volunteer service in which people engage for the common good, in particular in the social, ecological and cultural fields and in sports, integration and civil and disaster protection (Section 1).
promotion.publisher: Federal Ministry of Justice via Gesetze im Internet

promotion.title: Orders and honors
promotion.detail: The Federal President's office publishes information on the federal orders and on other decorations he awards, which include, for example, decorations for mine rescue work and for long-standing choirs, orchestras and clubs.

notable: Section 323c(2) also makes it a crime to obstruct someone who is helping or wants to help, and statutory accident insurance explicitly names helpers in emergencies as insured persons.
caveat: This is a plain-language summary, not legal advice. The English StGB text is a courtesy translation by Prof. Bohlander published for information only; the German text is the authoritative one, and my renderings of the other German statutes are my own. Tax figures change over time and I did not verify how the provisions work in practice.
